quality.explanation: Evaluated as an attacker: goals, assists, xG and xA per 90 minutes, ranked against Serie A players in the same position group with 450+ minutes this season. Doesn't account for team style or opposition quality -- a low score can reflect a team's system as much as individual quality.
quality.specialist_caveat: This player's individual metrics vary widely (a 67-percentile-point spread) -- the composite score above may understate whichever specific trait they're actually best known for.
